_about: All words the booth says, shows or prints live in this file. Replace the placeholder text; keep the ids, keys and structure. Ids are referenced elsewhere in this file and in the logs, so rename an id only if you update every reference.

consent.title: Before you start
body: This is a research prototype from the CDT in AI for Digital Media Inclusion hackathon.
If you take part, the booth logs what you press and choose, against a made-up wristband number. It does not log your name.
If you speak or type an answer, the words are logged so we can improve the wording. No audio is ever recorded or kept.
Logs are only used to find where the booth is confusing, and are deleted after Presentation Day.
Taking part is optional. You can stop at any time by hanging up.

voices._about: Each character speaks with one voice. 'voice_hint' is the speaking style sent to the Gemini voice, and 'gemini_voice' is one of Gemini's prebuilt voice names (Zephyr, Puck, Charon, Kore, Fenrir, Leda, Orus, Aoede, Sulafat, Enceladus and others). The browser voice ignores both.

operator.scan_prompt: Hello. Tap your wristband on the reader to begin. Or press star to continue without scanning.
operator.greeting_new: Welcome to the booth. This call takes about two minutes, and you can hang up at any time.
operator.greeting_returning: Welcome back. I've kept your place.
operator.greeting_anonymous: Welcome. Nothing from this call will be linked to you. You can hang up at any time.

menu.say: Press 1 to find your class. Press 2 for a quest. Press 3 for help. Press 4 to listen to an echo. Press 5 to print your journey so far.
menu._note: The menu offers 5 options on purpose, read as a list. Every other prompt keeps to 3.

operator.controls_hint: At any time, press 9 to hear that again, or 0 to come back to me.
operator.not_understood: Sorry, I didn't catch that. You can press a number instead.
operator.confirm_template: I think you said {option}. Press 1 if that's right, or 2 to choose again.
operator.quiz_first: Before your quest, let's find your class. It takes about a minute.
operator.goodbye: Thank you for calling. Hang up whenever you're ready.
operator.silence_nudge: Take your time. Here are the options again.
operator.printing: Printing your journey now. Take the slip from the printer.

safety._about: Fixed text, never generated. Plays when the safety option is chosen or when a distress word is heard. Agree the wording with Boomtown welfare.
safety.message: If you need help right now, the welfare tent is placeholder location. Any steward in a placeholder colour jacket can help you too.

quiz._about: Each answer adds points to one or more classes. The highest total wins. A tie goes to the class listed first in 'tie_break_order'.
quiz.intro: Answer five quick questions. There are no wrong answers.

needs._about: Asked before a quest is given. Each answer sets one need. Spoken answers are matched to an option by the decision step; 'hints' are example words used by the free keyword fallback.
needs.intro: Three quick questions, so I can find the right quest for you.

questions.say: Would you like somewhere quiet, or somewhere busy? Press 1 for quiet, 2 for busy.
On your own, or with other people? Press 1 for on my own, 2 for with others.
A short quest, or a longer one? Press 1 for short, 2 for longer.

routing._about: How a quest branch is chosen. Within the visitor's class, every branch is scored against the visitor's needs: each matching tag adds its weight. Highest score wins. Weights are unequal on purpose, so there are never ties, and 'social' counts most because group quests can be off-putting. With no class yet, the visitor is sent to the quiz first.
routing.quieter_swap: When a visitor asks to swap to a quieter or easier quest, the next-highest scoring branch in their class with energy 'quiet' is chosen; if none, the next-highest scoring branch.

quest_flow.step_prompt: Press 1 when you've done this step. Press 2 to hear it again. Press 3 if you need help.
quest_flow.all_done: You've finished every quest for your class. Press 4 from the main menu to hear an echo.

helper._about: The Quest helper. Answers are fixed text. 'action' topics do something instead of only speaking.
helper.intro: What do you need? Press 1 for what's next in my quest, 2 for an easier or quieter quest, 3 for more help.
helper.more_intro: Press 1 if you're lost, 2 for a quiet place, 3 for something else.

summary._about: The printed journey summary. The AI may only describe events from the visitor's log; it never adds story, places or quests. If the AI is off or fails, 'template' is used.
summary.ai_instructions: Write 3 to 5 short sentences, warm and plain, describing what this visitor did, using only the events given. Mention their class, quests and steps done, echoes heard, and their next step. Do not invent places, characters, story or events. No more than 90 words.
summary.template: You are {class_name}. You have done {steps_done} quest steps on {branch_name}. Echoes heard: {echoes_heard}. Next: {next_step}.
summary.footer: Keep this slip. Your journey continues.
